items.headline: Holmes throws 3 TD passes to Morrow, Buffalo makes late goal-line stand, beats Albany 21-17
items.description: — Chance Morrow caught his third touchdown pass from Elijah Holmes with 4:23 left and Buffalo beat Albany 21-17 early Friday in a game that was delayed about 2 3/4 hours at the start because of rain.
